name: Mmalite Machine Learning
objectives: Na-enweghị ndetu, ịkọwa ihe machine learning bụ ma mata ma ọrụ bụ classification ka ọ bụ regression, site na nkọwa ziri ezi na opekata mpe ọrụ 4 n'ime 5 e kewara nke ọma

Mgbe e nyere gị nsogbu amụma, ime obere dataset nwere feature ndị kwesịrị ekwesị na label, ma lelee ma ihe ọ bụla na-efu, site na feature ndị na-emetụta azịza, otu kọlụm label na opekata mpe otu ihe nwere ike ịna-efu a kpọrọ aha
Mgbe e nyere gị dataset na azịza nnwale model, ịkọwa ihe mere e ji ekewa data ka ọ bụrụ training set na test set ma gbakọọ izi ezi (accuracy), site n'izi ezi ziri ezi ruo pasentị zuru ezu kacha nso
Na Google Colab nwere scikit-learn, ibulite dataset omume ma kọwaa row ya, feature ya na label ya, na-akpọ ọnụ ọgụgụ row na kọlụm na ihe label pụtara
Mgbe e nyere gị dataset iris, ikewa data ahụ, zụọ decision tree ma bipụta izi ezi ya na test set, site na koodu na-agba n'enweghị njehie na izi ezi e bipụtara
Mgbe e nyere gị model abụọ a zụrụ azụ, ịtụnyere izi ezi nnwale ha, buo amụma maka ihe atụ ọhụrụ ma dee otu ebe ike model ị họrọ kwụsịrị, na-ahọrọ model nwere ihe kpatara ya ma na-akpọ aha ezi oke ya

chapters.name: Isi 1: Otu igwe si amụta ihe

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Ihe machine learning bụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 4
Ebumnuche: Kọwaa machine learning n'okwu nke gị ma hụ ya na ndụ kwa ụbọchị.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Na-enweghị ndetu, ị ga-enwe ike ịkọwa ihe machine learning bụ ma mata ma ọrụ bụ classification ka ọ bụ regression, site na nkọwa ziri ezi na opekata mpe ọrụ 4 n'ime 5 e kewara nke ọma.
Na mmemme kọmputa nkịtị, mmadụ na-ede iwu. Na machine learning (ML), ị na-enye kọmputa ọtụtụ ihe atụ nwere azịza ziri ezi, ọ na-achọta iwu ndị ahụ n'onwe ya. A na-akpọ ihe ọ mepụtara model.
Ihe atụ kwa ụbọchị: email gị na-amụta otu spam si dị site n'ọtụtụ nde email a kara akara. App egwu na-atụ aro egwu site n'ihe ndị dị ka gị gụrụ. App map na-ebu amụma ọgbaghara ụzọ site na njem gara aga.
Ọrụ abụọ a na-ahụkarị: classification na-etinye ihe n'otu (spam ma ọ bụ ọ bụghị spam, ụdị okooko osisi). Regression na-ebu amụma nọmba (ọnụ ahịa ụlọ, nkeji ole fọdụrụ ka bọs bịa). Mgbe ihe atụ ndị ahụ nwere azịza, a na-akpọ ya supervised learning, nke ahụ ka ihe ọmụmụ a na-akụzi.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Machine learning (ML): kọmputa na-achọta usoro n'ihe atụ kama ịgbaso iwu mmadụ dere.
- Model: ihe ML na-emepụta: usoro a mụtara nke na-ebu amụma.
- Classification: ibu amụma otu ma ọ bụ ụdị ihe.
- Regression: ibu amụma nọmba.
- Supervised learning: ịmụta ihe site n'ihe atụ nwere azịza ziri ezi.
Nwaa ugbu a: Depụta app atọ ị na-eji nke nwere ike iji machine learning. Maka nke ọ bụla, dee ihe ọ na-ebu amụma ya na ma ọ bụ classification (otu) ka ọ bụ regression (nọmba).
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkọwa ihe machine learning bụ ma mata ọdịiche dị n'etiti classification na regression.

check.q: Na machine learning, gịnị bụ model?
options: Ndepụta iwu mmadụ ji aka dee
Ihe kọmputa mepụtara mgbe ọ chọtara usoro n'ihe atụ
check.why: Model bụ ihe kọmputa na-emepụta mgbe ọ chọtara usoro n'ihe atụ.

check.q: Ụlọ ahịa chọrọ ikewa email ndị ahịa ka ọ bụrụ "mkpesa" ma ọ bụ "ajụjụ". Kedu ụdị ọrụ ị ga-akpọ nke a?
check.why: Itinye ihe n'otu bụ classification; ibu amụma nọmba bụ regression.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Data: feature na label
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Wuo obere dataset nwere feature na label.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị nsogbu amụma, ị ga-enwe ike ime obere dataset nwere feature ndị kwesịrị ekwesị na label, ma lelee ma ihe ọ bụla na-efu, site na feature ndị na-emetụta azịza, otu kọlụm label na opekata mpe otu ihe nwere ike ịna-efu a kpọrọ aha.
ML na-amụta ihe site na data, nke na-abụkarị tebụl. Row ọ bụla bụ otu ihe atụ. Kọlụm ndị na-akọwa ihe atụ ahụ bụ feature. Kọlụm nwere azịza ị chọrọ ibu amụma ya bụ label.
Ihe atụ: iji buo amụma ma bọs ga-egbu oge, row ọ bụla bụ otu njem. Feature nwere ike ịbụ oge n'ụbọchị, ụbọchị n'izu na ma mmiri zoro. Label bụ ma o gburu oge ka ọ bịara n'oge.
Feature dị mma bụ ihe na-emetụta azịza n'ezie. Row ndị ọzọ na-enyekarị aka. Data ahụ ga-ezikwa ezi ma zuo ezu: ọ bụrụ na i nakọtara naanị njem ụbọchị ọrụ, model ahụ agaghị arụ ọrụ nke ọma na ngwụsị izu. Model enweghị ike ịka data ya mma.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Kpebie ihe ị chọrọ ibu amụma ya: nke ahụ bụ label gị.
- Depụta ihe nwere ike imetụta ya: ndị ahụ bụ feature gị.
- Mee tebụl nwere otu row maka ihe atụ ọ bụla.
- Dejupụta opekata mpe row 10 site na ndụ n'ezie.
- Lelee: ụdị ihe atụ ụfọdụ ọ na-efu?
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Dataset: nchịkọta ihe atụ, na-abụkarị tebụl.
- Feature: kọlụm na-akọwa ihe atụ, nke e ji ebu amụma.
- Label: kọlụm azịza model na-amụta ibu amụma ya.
- Bias na data: mgbe data hapụrụ ma ọ bụ gụbigara ụfọdụ otu ọnụ, nke mere na model adịghị ezi ma ọ bụ na-ehie ụzọ maka ha.
Nwaa ugbu a: Họrọ ihe ị nwere ike ibu amụma ya site na ndụ kwa ụbọchị, dị ka ma ike ga-agwụ gị mgbe omume egwuregwu gasịrị ma ọ bụ ma ụlọ ahịa ga-ejupụta. Mee tebụl nwere feature abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ na label, ma dejupụta row 10.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịhọrọ label na feature bara uru ma wuo obere dataset.

check.q: Na tebụl data, gịnị bụ feature?
options: Kọlụm ndị na-akọwa ihe atụ ọ bụla
Azịza ị chọrọ ibu amụma ya
check.why: Feature na-akọwa ihe atụ; label bụ azịza a ga-ebu amụma ya.

check.q: Ị na-anakọta data maka ụmụ akwụkwọ na-emecha ihe omume ụlọ, mana naanị site n'otu klas. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme tupu ọzụzụ?
options: Zụọ ozugbo; otu klas zuru maka mmadụ niile
Nakọta data site na klas ndị ọzọ ka model ahụ zie ezi nye ụmụ akwụkwọ ndị ọzọ
check.why: Data sitere n'otu otu nwere ike ime ka model ghara ịrụ ọrụ nke ọma ma ọ bụ ghara izi ezi nye ndị ọzọ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Ọzụzụ na nnwale: model ahụ ọ dị mma?
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kewaa data ka ọ bụrụ training set na test set ma tụọ izi ezi.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị dataset na azịza nnwale model, ị ga-enwe ike ịkọwa ihe mere e ji ekewa data ka ọ bụrụ training set na test set ma gbakọọ izi ezi (accuracy), site n'izi ezi ziri ezi ruo pasentị zuru ezu kacha nso.
Ọzụzụ (training) bụ mgbe model na-amụ ihe atụ iji chọta usoro. Mana model nke buru naanị ihe atụ ya n'isi nwere ike ịdị ka ọ zuru oke ma daa n'ihe atụ ọhụrụ. A na-akpọ nke a overfitting, dị ka nwa akwụkwọ buru azịza ule afọ gara aga n'isi.
Ya mere ị na-edobe ụfọdụ data n'akụkụ. A na-eji training set (na-abụkarị ihe dị ka pasentị 75 ruo 80 nke row) amụta ihe. Test set (ndị fọdụrụ) na-ezo ezo ruo n'ọgwụgwụ, a na-ejikwa ya elele model ahụ n'ihe atụ ọ hụbeghị mgbe ọ bụla.
Izi ezi (accuracy) bụ akụkụ nke ihe atụ nnwale o nwetara nke ọma. 18 ziri ezi n'ime 20 bụ pasentị 90. Jụọ mgbe niile ihe mperi na-efu: ntụaro egwu ezighi ezi adịghị njọ, mana ịdọ aka na ntị aghụghọ e furu efu dị njọ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Gbanwee usoro row gị (shuffle).
- Tinye ihe dị ka pasentị 75 na training set.
- Debe ndị fọdụrụ dị ka test set, elekwala ha anya.
- Chọta usoro (iwu) site na training set naanị.
- Jiri ya na test set ma gụọ ole o nwetara nke ọma.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Training (ọzụzụ): model na-amụta usoro site n'ihe atụ.
- Training set: row e ji amụta ihe.
- Test set: row e debere n'akụkụ iji lelee model n'ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
- Overfitting: mgbe model buru data ọzụzụ ya n'isi ma ghara ịrụ ọrụ nke ọma na data ọhụrụ.
- Accuracy (izi ezi): akụkụ nke amụma ndị ziri ezi.
Nwaa ugbu a: Were tebụl row 10 gị site na Nkuzi 2. Kpuchie row 2 ikpeazụ. Site na 8 mbụ, dee otu iwu dị mfe (dịka ọmụmaatụ "ọ bụrụ na mmiri zoro, bọs ga-egbu oge"). Nwalee iwu ahụ na row 2 e zoro ezo ma gbakọọ izi ezi ya.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ikewa data ka ọ bụrụ training set na test set ma gbakọọ izi ezi.

options: Mgbe model dị obere nke ukwuu
Mgbe data nnwale dị ukwuu nke ukwuu
Mgbe model buru ihe atụ ọzụzụ ya n'isi ma daa n'ndị ọhụrụ
check.why: Overfitting dị ka ibu azịza ule afọ gara aga n'isi.

check.q: Model aghụghọ nwetara izi ezi 95%, mana ndị o furu bụ ezi aghụghọ. Gịnị ka ị ga-ajụ ọzọ?
options: Gịnị ka mperi ndị ahụ na-efu?
Anyị nwere ike ịhapụ test set?
Anyị nwere ike ịzụ na test set?
check.why: Jụọ mgbe niile ihe mperi na-efu; ịdọ aka na ntị aghụghọ e furu efu dị mkpa nke ukwuu.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Ịzụ model mbụ gị na Colab

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Ibulite dataset site na scikit-learn
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Bulite dataset omume na Colab ma lee feature na label ya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Na Google Colab nwere scikit-learn, ị ga-enwe ike ibulite dataset omume ma kọwaa row ya, feature ya na label ya, na-akpọ ọnụ ọgụgụ row na kọlụm na ihe label pụtara.
scikit-learn bụ library Python n'efu maka machine learning, nke a wụnyelarị na Google Colab. O nwere obere dataset omume. Dataset iris nwere okooko osisi 150. Nke ọ bụla nwere feature anọ (ogologo na obosara akụkụ abụọ nke okooko osisi ahụ, na centimita) na label: otu n'ime ụdị atọ.
Bulite ya site na: from sklearn.datasets import load_iris, wee iris = load_iris(). Feature dị na iris.data, label dịkwa na iris.target. iris.feature_names na iris.target_names na-agwa gị ihe kọlụm na label pụtara.
Lee data gị mgbe niile tupu ọzụzụ: row ole, kọlụm ndị ahụ bụ gịnị, na row ole na ole dị ka ihe atụ. iris.data.shape na-agwa gị row na kọlụm: (150, 4).
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Meghee notebook ọhụrụ na colab.research.google.com.
- Gbaa: from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
- Gbaa: iris = load_iris()
- Bipụta iris.data.shape, iris.feature_names na iris.target_names.
- Bipụta row atọ mbụ: print(iris.data[:3], iris.target[:3])
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- scikit-learn: library Python n'efu maka machine learning, a na-ebubata ya dị ka sklearn.
- Dataset iris: dataset omume a ma ama nke okooko osisi 150 n'ụdị atọ.
- shape: ọnụ ọgụgụ row na kọlụm dị na data.
- X na y: aha a na-ejikarị: X maka feature, y maka label.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- scikit-learn: Ịmalite
- Google Colab: Ajụjụ a na-ajụkarị
Nwaa ugbu a: Bulite dataset iris na Colab. Bipụta shape, aha feature anọ ahụ, aha ụdị atọ ahụ, na row ise mbụ ya na label ha. Dee nọmba nọchiri anya ụdị ọ bụla.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ibulite dataset na Colab ma kọwaa feature ya, label ya na nha ya.

check.q: Na dataset iris nke scikit-learn, gịnị dị n'ime iris.target?
check.why: iris.target nwere label; iris.data nwere feature.

check.q: Ị ka bulitere dataset ọhụrụ. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme tupu ịzụ model?
options: Lee shape, aha kọlụm na row ole na ole dị ka ihe atụ
check.why: Lee data gị mgbe niile tupu ọzụzụ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Ịzụ na ịnwale decision tree
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Kewaa data, zụọ decision tree, ma tụọ izi ezi ya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị dataset iris, ị ga-enwe ike ikewa data ahụ, zụọ decision tree ma bipụta izi ezi ya na test set, site na koodu na-agba n'enweghị njehie na izi ezi e bipụtara.
Decision tree na-amụta usoro ajụjụ ee-ma-ọ-bụ-mba, dị ka flowchart: "Petal ọ dị mkpụmkpụ karịa 2.5 cm? Mgbe ahụ ọ bụ ụdị 0." Ọ dị mfe ịkọwa, nke na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ezigbo model mbụ.
Model scikit-learn ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ n'otu ụzọ: mepụta ya, fit ya na data ọzụzụ, wee predict na data ọhụrụ. Koodu ahụ: X, y = load_iris(return_X_y=True). X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42). model = DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42). model.fit(X_train, y_train).
Wee nwalee ya: predictions = model.predict(X_test) na print(accuracy_score(y_test, predictions)). random_state=42 na-edozi naanị usoro shuffle ka ị nweta otu azịza ahụ oge ọ bụla ị gbara ya.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Bubata: from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
- Bubata: from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
- Bubata: from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
- Kewaa site na train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42).
- Mepụta model, kpọọ model.fit(X_train, y_train), wee predict na X_test ma bipụta izi ezi.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Decision tree: model na-amụta flowchart nke ajụjụ ee-ma-ọ-bụ-mba.
- fit: ịzụ model na data.
- predict: iji model a zụrụ azụ chepụta label maka data ọhụrụ.
- train_test_split: ngwa scikit-learn na-ekewa data ka ọ bụrụ training set na test set.
- random_state: nọmba na-edozi shuffle ka azịza wee na-emeghachi otu ahụ.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- scikit-learn: Ịmalite
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee ma gbaa koodu decision tree niile na Colab. Bipụta izi ezi. Wee gbanwee test_size ka ọ bụrụ 0.5, gbaa ya ọzọ, ma dee ma izi ezi rịgoro ka ọ dara.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ikewa data, zụọ decision tree site na fit, predict site na ya ma tụọ izi ezi.

check.q: Gịnị mere decision tree ji bụrụ ezigbo model mbụ?
options: Ọ dị mfe ịkọwa, dị ka flowchart nke ajụjụ ee-ma-ọ-bụ-mba
Ọ naghị emehie ihe mgbe ọ bụla
Ọ na-arụ ọrụ naanị na okooko osisi
check.why: Enwere ike ịgụ ajụjụ decision tree dị ka flowchart.

check.q: I zụrụ model gị ma chọọ ilele ya. Kedu ahịrị ị ga-agba?
check.why: Predict na test set, wee tụnyere ya na ezi label maka izi ezi.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Ịtụnyere model na ịmata oke ha
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Zụọ model nke abụọ, tụnyere ya na nke mbụ, buo amụma maka ihe atụ ọhụrụ ma kpọọ aha otu oke.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị model abụọ a zụrụ azụ, ị ga-enwe ike ịtụnyere izi ezi nnwale ha, buo amụma maka ihe atụ ọhụrụ ma dee otu ebe ike model ị họrọ kwụsịrị, na-ahọrọ model nwere ihe kpatara ya ma na-akpọ aha ezi oke ya.
Ọ dịkarịghị otu model zuru oke, ya mere ị na-anwale karịa otu. k-nearest neighbors (KNN) na-ebu amụma site n'ịchọta ihe atụ k kacha yie ya na data ọzụzụ ma were votu. Mepụta ya site na KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=5) sitere na sklearn.neighbors; ọ na-eji otu nzọụkwụ fit na predict ahụ.
Tụnyere model abụọ ahụ n'otu test set. Iji buo amụma maka otu okooko osisi ọhụrụ, nye model ahụ list n'ime list: model.predict([[5.1, 3.5, 1.4, 0.2]]). Ọ na-eweghachi nọmba ụdị ahụ; iris.target_names na-eme ka ọ bụrụ aha.
Mara oke ha. Model ndị a maara naanị ụdị atọ a na ntụle anọ a: gosi ha rose, ha ga-akpọ ya iris. Test set dị obere nwere ike ime ka izi ezi dị ka ọ ka mma ma ọ bụ ka njọ karịa ka ọ dị. Na ezi data gbasara mmadụ, lelee na model ahụ na-arụ ọrụ n'ụzọ ziri ezi nye otu ọ bụla tupu onye ọ bụla adabere na ya.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Bubata: from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
- Mepụta knn = KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=5) ma fit ya n'otu data ọzụzụ ahụ.
- Bipụta akara izi ezi abụọ ahụ.
- Buo amụma maka otu okooko osisi ọhụrụ site na model ka mma: model.predict([[5.1, 3.5, 1.4, 0.2]])
- Dee model ị ga-ahọrọ na otu oke ya.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- k-nearest neighbors (KNN): model na-ebu amụma site na votu nke ihe atụ ọzụzụ kacha yie ya.
- n_neighbors: ihe atụ ole yiri ya KNN na-ele (k).
- Oke (limit): ọnọdụ model enweghị ike ijikwa nke ọma.
- Ikpe ziri ezi (fairness): model na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma n'otu aka ahụ nye otu mmadụ ọ bụla o metụtara.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- scikit-learn: Ịmalite
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: n'otu notebook, zụọ decision tree na model KNN n'otu nkewa ahụ, bipụta izi ezi abụọ ahụ, buo amụma ụdị okooko osisi [6.0, 2.9, 4.5, 1.5] site na model ka mma ma bipụta aha ya, wee dee ahịrịokwu abụọ maka model ị họrọ na otu oke o nwere.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịzụ, nwalee ma tụnyere model abụọ, buo amụma, ma kọwaa oke model.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Ibulite na ikewa data Data ahụ anaghị ebulite, ma ọ bụ a na-anwale model na data ọzụzụ. E bulitere data iris ma kewaa ya ka ọ bụrụ training set na test set site na train_test_split. Ọ na-ebipụtakwa shape nke set ọ bụla ma kọwaa nkewa ahụ. Model abụọ a zụrụ ma nwalee Naanị otu model ka a zụrụ, ma ọ bụ izi ezi adịghị. A zụrụ decision tree na model KNN, e bipụtakwara izi ezi nnwale nke ọ bụla. Ọ na-anwalekwa uru nke abụọ nke n_neighbors ma tụnyere ha. Amụma maka okooko osisi ọhụrụ Enweghị amụma, ma ọ bụ ihe e nyere dị n'ọdịdị ezighi ezi. Model ka mma na-ebu amụma maka otu okooko osisi ọhụrụ, e bipụtakwara aha ụdị ahụ. Ọ na-akọwakwa ihe mere amụma ahụ ji kwekọọ na ntụle ndị ahụ. Nhọrọ na oke Ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ adịghị, ma ọ bụ a kpọghị aha ezi oke ọ bụla. Ahịrịokwu abụọ: model ọ bụ na ihe kpatara ya, na otu ezi oke. Ọ na-ekwukwa maka ihe mperi na-efu ma ọ bụ ikpe ziri ezi maka data gbasara mmadụ. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.
